description: Fixed negative fixture for the exact official OpenCode release v1.18.26 / 774cc7c1914e4329eefde5a669f938b0cf566661. A no-model prompt_async carrying format.type=json_schema + noReply returns 204 (admission only); the V1 message list and single-user-message reads both return 400 (schema decode failure). This release is ineligible and the probe must make zero provider/model prompt calls. The record is keyed by the exact release asset, platform, architecture, and candidate-binary digest, never by presenting one platform's hash as release-wide.
operator_launch_record: Operator started the official direct OpenCode server from this candidate with OPENCODE_DATA=<data-root> so Global.Path.data resolves to the declared --server-data-root; restarted the same binary and data root between phases. This manual fact is trusted only for S0 investment eligibility and is not production evidence.
